items.lb0: Dogs bark when strangers come near the house.
items.lb1: A crab walks sideways on the beach. Watch out for its claws!
items.lb2: In the forest, a deer is quietly eating grass.
items.lb3: The dinosaur in this museum is a T. rex.
items.lb4: A dolphin is a smart sea animal. It likes to jump out of the water and play.
items.lb5: A donkey looks like a small horse with long ears.
items.lb6: The eagle is a big bird. It flies high in the sky and catches fish with its sharp claws.
items.lb7: Grandpa has a farm with cows, pigs and chickens.
items.lb8: A goat can climb rocks, and it gives us milk.
items.lb9: A goose is a big white bird. It honks loudly at people.
items.lb10: The hippopotamus is very big and spends most of the day in the river.
items.lb11: A bee is an insect. It has six legs.
items.lb12: A kangaroo carries its baby in a pouch on its belly.
items.lb13: The bird made a nest in the tree with small sticks.
items.lb14: My parrot can say "Hello!" It has bright green feathers.
items.lb15: A trained pigeon can carry a message back to its home.
items.lb16: A puppy is a baby dog.
items.lb17: Swim away fast! A shark has hundreds of sharp teeth.
items.lb18: This spider has eight legs and makes a web to catch bugs.
items.lb19: My dog wags its tail when it's happy.
items.lb20: The blue whale is the biggest animal in the world.
items.lb21: At night, the wolf howls to other wolves.
items.lb22: In the Stardew Valley mines, a bat flies out of the dark.
items.lb23: There is a little bug on my sandwich. Is it an ant?
items.lb24: Our hamster lives in a cage in my bedroom.
items.lb25: I saw a big brown cockroach in the kitchen! It has six legs and two long antennae.
items.lb26: This bird lost a feather. It's soft and light.
items.lb27: The cows are eating grass in the field.
items.lb28: Lions and tigers are wild animals. They don't live with people.
items.lb29: A zebra looks like a horse with black and white stripes.
items.ro2: Does a bat sleep during the day?
items.ro4: A kangaroo can jump very far.
items.ro5: The eagle builds its nest in a tall tree.
items.ro6: My puppy wags its tail when it sees me.
items.ro8: A spider is not an insect.
items.ro10: There are some goats on the farm.
items.ro11: The parrot doesn't live in a cage.
items.ro13: No, it doesn't. It eats grass.
items.ro15: The goose is chasing my little brother!
items.ro16: Dinosaurs lived on Earth a long time ago.
items.ro17: A wolf has a long tail and sharp teeth.
items.ro18: Pigeons are flying over the field.
items.ro19: My uncle has a donkey on his farm.
items.passage0: In Stardew Valley, my farmer has two goats and a puppy on his farm. Every morning, he gives the goats some hay. His goats give him milk every other day. The puppy follows him to the field. At night, he goes into the mines. Bats fly out of the dark, so he always brings his sword.
items.passage1: Last Friday, our class went to the zoo. First, we saw a big hippopotamus. It stayed in the water most of the time. Then we watched the kangaroos. A baby kangaroo was in its mother's pouch. My favorite animal was the zebra. Its black and white stripes are so beautiful. I want to go again!
items.passage2: Whales, dolphins and sharks all live in the sea, but they are different. A shark is a fish. A whale and a dolphin are not fish. They have to come up to breathe air. Dolphins are very smart. They live in groups and talk to each other with clicks and whistles.
items.passage3: Last night, my sister screamed. There was a big cockroach in the kitchen! Dad caught it with a paper cup and put it outside. Then I saw a spider in the corner of my room. I didn't kill it. Spiders eat bugs, so they help us. Now I call my spider Mr. Eight Legs.
items.passage4: In our town game, Jack saw a whale near the harbor this morning. Max told everyone to stay out of the water. "Whales are wild animals, and they are very big," he said. Mia took a photo of the whale from the beach. Now the photo is on the library wall, and everyone stops to look at it.
